extracted.intended_audience: Post Office Department officials, government accountants, and legal researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Statutory provisions (24th Congress, 1836) setting duties, authorities, reporting and recordkeeping requirements for the Treasurer, an Auditor of the Treasury for the Post Office Department, and the Postmaster General with respect to accounts, warrants, and departmental financial administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treasurer's quarterly account renderings
rubrics_metrics.description: The Treasurer shall render his accounts of the moneys received and paid by him on account of the Post Office Department, quarterly to the Auditor for the Post Office Department, and shall transmit copies of the same, when adjusted by him, to the two Houses of Congress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires regular (quarterly) submission of adjusted accounts to the departmental auditor and transmission of copies to both Houses of Congress; implies timeliness and adjustment before transmission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment of Auditor for the Post Office Department
rubrics_metrics.description: There shall be appointed by the President, with the consent of the Senate, an Auditor of the Treasury for the Post Office Department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes appointment method (executive nomination with Senate confirmation) for the office charged with auditing departmental accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Auditor's core audit and certification duties
rubrics_metrics.description: The Auditor's duty it shall be to receive all accounts arising in the said Department, or relative thereto, to audit and settle the same, and certify their balances to the Postmaster General.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines primary functions: receipt of accounts, auditing and settlement, and formal certification of balances to the Postmaster General.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right of appeal from auditor's settlement
rubrics_metrics.description: If either the Postmaster General, or any person whose account shall be settled, be dissatisfied therewith, he may, within twelve months, appeal to the First Comptroller of the Treasury, whose decision shall be final and conclusive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies procedural remedy and one-year time limit for appeals from auditor settlements; establishes the First Comptroller's decision as final.

rubrics_metrics.name: Auditor to prescribe official forms and accountkeeping methods
rubrics_metrics.description: The said auditor shall report to the Postmaster General, when required, the official forms of papers to be used by postmasters, and other officers or agents of the Department concerned in its receipts and payments, and the manner and form of keeping and stating its accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the auditor authority/responsibility to standardize forms and accounting methods for departmental officers, on request of the Postmaster General.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation of accounts and vouchers after settlement
rubrics_metrics.description: He shall keep and preserve all accounts, with the vouchers, after settlement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandates retention of settled accounts and supporting vouchers by the auditor for recordkeeping and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty to report delinquencies of postmasters
rubrics_metrics.description: He shall promptly report to the Postmaster General all delinquencies of postmasters in paying over the proceeds of their offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires timely communication of failures by postmasters to remit proceeds, enabling oversight and corrective action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quarterly closing and reporting of departmental accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: He shall close the accounts of the Department quarterly, and transmit to the Secretary of the Treasury quarterly statements of its receipts and expenditures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires periodic (quarterly) account closing and submission of receipts/expenditures statements to the Treasury Secretary for centralized financial oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to register, charge and countersign warrants
rubrics_metrics.description: He shall register, charge and countersign, all warrants upon the Treasury for receipts and payments issued by the Postmaster General, when warranted by law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assigns the auditor a control function over Treasury warrants issued by the Postmaster General, subject to legal authorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other duties and reporting to Treasury officials
rubrics_metrics.description: He shall perform such other duties, in relation to the financial concerns of the Department, as shall be assigned to him by the Secretary of the Treasury, and shall make to them respectively, such reports as either of them may require respecting the same.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a catch-all delegation power for the Secretary to assign additional financial duties and reporting obligations to the auditor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Franking and free postage privileges for auditor and Chief Engineer correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: The said auditor may frank, and receive, free of postage, letters and packets under the regulations provided by law for other officers of the Government. And all letters and packets to and from the Chief Engineer which may relate to the business of his office shall be free of postage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants limited postal privileges to the auditor and official departmental engineering correspondence; procedural privilege rather than accounting rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postmaster General's authority to determine official forms and accountkeeping
rubrics_metrics.description: It shall be the duty of the Postmaster General to decide on the official forms of all papers to be used by postmasters, and other officers or agents of the Post Office Department, concerned in its receipts and payments, and the manner and form of keeping and stating its accounts;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assigns to the Postmaster General the responsibility to select forms and prescribe accountkeeping methods for use in the field; this overlaps with auditor's role to report forms when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement of prompt rendition of returns and supporting papers
rubrics_metrics.description: to enforce the prompt rendition of the returns of postmasters, and of all certificates, acknowledgments, receipts, and other papers, by postmasters and contractors, relative to the accounts of the Department;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandates active enforcement by the Postmaster General to ensure timely submission of required financial returns and documentation from postmasters and contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control of allowances and expenses subject to auditor settlement
rubrics_metrics.description: to control, according to law, and subject to the settlement of the auditor, the allowances to postmasters, the expenses of post offices, and all other expenses incident to the service of the Department; to regulate and direct the payment of the said allowances and expenses for which appropriations have been made;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the Postmaster General authority over allowances and expenses but makes such control subject to the auditor's settlement; payments must align with appropriations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Superintendence of proceeds and prescription of payment manner
rubrics_metrics.description: to superintend the disposition of the proceeds of post offices and other moneys of the Department; to prescribe the manner in which postmasters shall pay over their balances;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires oversight of how departmental funds are disposed and authority to set procedures for postmasters' remittances of balances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to grant warrants for certified payments
rubrics_metrics.description: to grant warrants for money to be paid into the Treasury, and out of the same, in pursuance of appropriations by law, to persons to whom the same shall be certified to be due by the said auditor:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows the Postmaster General to issue warrants for payments or deposits where the auditor has certified amounts due, linking certification to disbursement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance payments to investigative or inspection agents
rubrics_metrics.description: Provided that advances of necessary sums to defray expenses may be made by the Postmaster General to agents of the Department employed to investigate mail depredations, examine post routes, and post offices, and perform other like services, to be charged by the auditor for the Post Office Department, and be accounted for in the settlement of their accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permits discretionary advances to agents for investigative/inspection work; such advances must be charged by the auditor and accounted for in settlements—establishes both temporary liquidity authority and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quarterly certification of moneys paid pursuant to appropriations (beginning Sec. 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: The auditor for the Post Office Department shall state and certify, quarterly, to the Postmaster General, accounts of moneys paid pursuant to appropriations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compels the auditor to issue quarterly certifications of expenditures made under appropriations to the Postmaster General, reinforcing periodic financial reporting (page text cuts off mid-provision).
